q: How do we count contract workers supplied by a staffing agency?
title: Contract workers in your inventory
short: Energy they use at your site is already in your Scope 1 and 2, because you control the site. The agency's fee is a purchased service, Scope 3 Category 1. Many companies include contract workers' commuting in Category 7 with employees; say whether you do.
audience: Factories and offices using contract labour

ul: Site electricity and fuel: your Scope 1 and 2.
Commuting and company transport: Category 7, or Scope 1 if you run the buses.

p: If you report per employee, state whether contract workers are in the headcount.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
